decisive_items: a large, heterogeneously attenuating right renal mass
heterogeneously enhancing expansile mass in the upper pole of the right kidney
tumoral extension into the right renal vein and inferior vena cava
response.rationale: The patient's presentation with a large renal mass, hematuria, and flank pain, along with imaging findings of a heterogeneously enhancing mass with invasion of the collecting system and vascular structures, is consistent with renal cell carcinoma.

rejected.why: no nephrolithiasis was seen on imaging
the mass is described as heterogeneously enhancing, which is not typical of angiomyolipoma
the patient is 27 years old, which is older than the typical age range for nephroblastoma
